meta.content: Medicine Hat College is a learner focused provider of quality education, training, and services to its community. Contact us at 403.529.3811.

div.p: Life’s journey is rarely a straight or simple path. Hear from people who haven't been certain about what they want to do with their life. Who have been apprehensive about pursuing higher education. Who have needed support along the way.

img.alt: MHC students and alumni share their stories.

div.p: So you can do what you love

Choose from science, arts, commerce and kinesiology! By starting your degree at MHC, you'll have the advantage of a high quality, yet personal learning experience that sets you up for success when the time comes to move to one of our partner universities.

div.div: New for 2024, MHC's Kinesiology diploma prepares graduates to work as qualified exercise professionals in a variety of fitness, health, sports, rehabilitation, and recreation environments.
Business Administration offers you the opportunity to focus on your strength and career goals, with majors in Accounting, Financial Services, Marketing, and Management.
Our Health Care Aide program is designed to equip you with the knowledge, skills and values necessary to function as a front-line caregiver in just eight months.

section.p: Medicine Hat College acknowledges and honours the traditional territories of the First Nation People of Treaty 7 and Treaty 4, and of the Métis people who share a deep history with this land. We recognize and honour the land, history, ways of being, and our relationship with First Nation, Métis, and Inuit people as we forge together towards a relationship of reconciliation, respect, understanding, and healing.
